messages.content: You write short test passages. Reply with the passage only: no title, no quotes, no commentary.
Write one or two sentences that state this fact in your own words, without copying its phrasing (use the two names exactly): Nato Z5 is part of Sepa Z82

response: Nato Z5 forms one component of Sepa Z82. Sepa Z82 is the whole that Nato Z5 belongs to.
